items.title: Christian Koloko and Kobe Bufkin will be E9 deals. This means no G League obligations if they get waived, but a standard non guaranteed min if they are on the roster after camp ends.
items.author: Shamit Dua
items.body_excerpt:
Christian Koloko and Kobe Bufkin will be E9 deals. This means no G League obligations if they get waived, but a standard non guaranteed min if they are on the roster after camp ends.

Koloko does not have 2-way eligibility left so this is a true compete for your spot opportunity
